news.headline: Headline

feeds.title: RSS Feeds
feeds.subtitle: Sources the news grid reads from. New domains must be on the server-side allowlist; everything is fetched through the SSRF-guarded proxy.
feeds.errDomain: This domain is not on the server allowlist. Add it to the allowlist first.
feeds.errRateLimited: Too many admin actions. Wait a minute and try again.
feeds.errForbiddenOrigin: This origin is blocked by the fetch guard.
feeds.errMissingUrl: A valid feed URL is required.
feeds.errGeneric: Action failed. Check the server logs.
feeds.emptyMigration: No feeds yet — migration 0004_admin_advanced.sql may not be applied to your Supabase project yet. Until then the built-in feed list is used automatically.
feeds.previewTitle: Preview parsed output via the admin-guarded action (proxied & SSRF-guarded)
feeds.cacheNote: Feed responses are cached for 5 minutes per server instance. Purge after changing sources.
feeds.msgPurgedLong: Feed cache purged on this server instance ✔
feeds.msgSynced: {count} feed(s) fetched now and caches refreshed.

users.title: Users

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.subtitle: Every admin write is recorded with actor, action and target. Newest first.
audit.emptyFull: No audit entries yet. Every admin write (articles, users, feeds, cache purge) is recorded here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.grantIntro: Signed in as {email}. Run this in Supabase SQL Dashboard:
settings.grantNote: Role changes are intentionally not exposed in the UI; only SQL moves the admin hat (least-privilege principle).
settings.sec1: All write actions: admin guard + rate limit (20/min) + server-side validation.
settings.sec2: Database CRUD only through SECURITY DEFINER RPCs with an internal is_admin() check.
settings.sec3: Every action is recorded in admin_audit_log (viewable from the SQL Dashboard).
settings.sec4: These routes are never indexed in robots or sitemap.
settings.themeNote: The panel stays dark to preserve table contrast.
